summary: ClauseClock Stage 1 backend + frontend testing complete. 11/11 pytest tests pass covering auth (register/login/me/logout, 401 without session), cross-user isolation (404 on foreign contract GET/DELETE, list scoping), user_id from client ignored, PDF ingestion (pdfplumber, Page markers, sha256, size, page_count, doc_role primary), DOCX ingestion (python-docx, § and ¶ markers), annual-value provenance (user_entered with all quote/document/location/offset null; null when omitted), scanned-PDF detection (blank PDF -> extraction_method=failed_no_text with exact scanned message), contract detail returns documents with raw_text, and hard deletion verified end-to-end including GridFS fs.files count returns to baseline. Frontend E2E flow verified: login at /login with seeded creds -> /app -> /app/upload -> submit PDF form -> lands on /app/contracts/{id} -> extracted text visible via document-rawtext testid containing 'Page' markers -> annual value $24,000 shown -> Delete + confirm -> returns to /app/contracts empty list.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: TEST_USER credentials are hardcoded — acceptable for Stage 1 seed but consider moving to env for later stages.
get_current_user only checks access_token cookie/Bearer; no refresh token rotation route implemented. Users get hard 401 after 12h with no auto-refresh path.
delete_contract cascades findings/actions/outcomes/reminders which are not created in Stage 1 — safe pre-wiring for later stages.
CORS: allow_origin_regex covers preview domains; allow_credentials=True works with samesite=none cookies. Good.
_oid signature takes unused user_id param — minor cleanup.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all test artifacts prefixed TEST_ are deleted at end of each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stage 1 ingestion is solid. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_clauseclock_stage1.py using pytest-xdist loadscope. Auth uses httpOnly cookies (samesite=none, secure) — always use requests.Session or set withCredentials. GridFS collections are fs.files/fs.chunks; hard delete removes them. For UI file uploads, upload-file-input is hidden — use page.set_input_files with state='attached' (not visible).
